title: Uncensor: Best Model Obliterator (Beat OBLITERATUS + Heretic)

stories.title: SVD-based Direction Extraction
stories.description: Add SVD and Whitened SVD extraction methods (OBLITERATUS key feature)
acceptanceCriteria: svd_extraction() function exists in src/extraction.py and returns tensor
whitened_svd_extraction() function exists and returns normalized directions
Benchmark: SVD extraction completes in <5s for 7B model on GPU
stories.note: svd_extraction and whitened_svd_extraction added to extraction.py with full tests

stories.title: Norm-Preserving Multi-Direction Projection
stories.description: Implement norm-preserving weight orthogonalization across multiple directions
acceptanceCriteria: Preserves weight norms after projecting multiple directions
stories.note: Already implemented via orthogonalize_weights with layer_weights

stories.title: Bias Term Projection
stories.description: Full bias term projection (OBLITERATUS feature, currently partial)
acceptanceCriteria: project_bias_terms() function exists and projects all bias vectors

stories.title: Cross-Layer Alignment Analyzer
stories.description: Analyze how refusal direction evolves across transformer layers

stories.title: Refusal Logit Lens
stories.description: Track refusal probability across layers to find decision point
acceptanceCriteria: identify_decision_layer() returns the layer where refusal 'decides'
stories.note: logit_lens.py fully implemented with batch_logit_lens, plot_refusal_trajectory

stories.title: Ouroboros Detector (Defense Robustness)
stories.description: Detect if guardrails self-repair after removal (OBLITERATUS unique feature)
acceptanceCriteria: detect_self_repair() returns whether refusal resurfaces after ablation
compensation_passes() calculates required passes to keep refusal below threshold

stories.title: Enhanced Concept Cone Geometry
stories.description: Map per-category refusal with solid angle estimation
acceptanceCriteria: EnhancedConceptConeAnalyzer computes solid_angle for category directions
is_polyhedral_vs_linear() returns whether refusal is one mechanism or many

stories.title: Iterative Refinement with Re-Probing
stories.description: Re-probe after each projection pass to catch rotated residual guardrails
acceptanceCriteria: Each pass measures refusal_rate and continues if > threshold
stories.note: iterative_subspace_extraction in extraction.py with re-probing and convergence

stories.title: Gradio Web UI
stories.description: Full Gradio interface with Obliterate/Benchmark/Chat tabs (OBLITERATUS has this)
acceptanceCriteria: app.py has Gradio interface with 4 tabs: Obliterate, Benchmark, Chat, Export
Obliterate tab: model dropdown, method selector, strength slider, results
Chat tab: interactive chat with original vs obliterated comparison
stories.note: app.py exists with full Gradio UI, model catalog integration

stories.title: HuggingFace Spaces Deployment
stories.description: Zero-setup web interface (OBLITERATUS key advantage)
acceptanceCriteria: Space metadata configured in README or separate file
Works on ZeroGPU (no GPU on user side required)
Badge in README links to live Space

stories.title: 116 Model Catalog
stories.description: Tiered model catalog with VRAM requirements (OBLITERATUS has 116 models)
acceptanceCriteria: Models categorized by tier: tiny (0.5B), small (1-3B), medium (7B), large (13B+), massive (70B+)
Each model has: name, vram_fp16, vram_int8, recommended_gpu,hf_url
CLI: obliteratus models --tier small shows filtered list
stories.note: model_catalog.json has ~50+ models across 5 tiers with full VRAM specs

stories.title: Community Leaderboard
stories.description: Anonymous result submission and aggregation (OBLITERATUS feature)
acceptanceCriteria: CLI: obliteratus aggregate shows ranked results

stories.title: LoRA-Based Reversible Ablation
stories.description: Rank-1 LoRA adapters instead of permanent weight surgery (OBLITERATUS novel)
acceptanceCriteria: Creates LoRA adapter that neutralizes refusal direction
Can be removed to restore original behavior
stories.note: LoRAReversibleAblation class implemented with apply/remove context manager

stories.title: SAE Decomposition Integration
stories.description: Sparse Autoencoder-based direction extraction (OBLITERATUS feature)
acceptanceCriteria: sae_extraction() function in src/extraction.py uses SAE-Lens
stories.note: sae_feature_ablation and load_sae_and_score_features implemented in interventions.py

stories.title: KL-Divergence Co-Optimization
stories.description: Post-projection feedback that partially reverts over-projected layers
acceptanceCriteria: Checks KL divergence after projection, reverts if budget exceeded

stories.title: Strength Sweep Visualization
stories.description: Vary coefficient and plot compliance vs coherence tradeoff
acceptanceCriteria: Plot generation with compliance vs coherence curves
CLI: obliteratus sweep --model MODEL generates visualization

stories.title: CoT-Aware Ablation
stories.description: Preserve chain-of-thought reasoning during ablation
acceptanceCriteria: Orthogonalizes refusal direction against reasoning directions

acceptanceCriteria: detect_alignment_method() returns: DPO, RLHF, CAI, or SFT

acceptanceCriteria: Runs analysis before extraction to tune parameters
